_about: Public-domain John Raleigh Mott (1865-1955), Methodist layman, leader of the YMCA, the Student Volunteer Movement and the World's Student Christian Federation, and chairman of the 1910 Edinburgh Missionary Conference, for the Word Hoard: History of the Student Volunteer Movement, Strategic Points in the World's Conquest, The Evangelization of the World in this Generation, The Pastor and Modern Missions, The Future Leadership of the Church, The Decisive Hour of Christian Missions, and his addresses (1899-1910). He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 102 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
